reel.name: Reel 001 · Built by two agents (the studio itself)
reel.route: your real frames as the reference → podcast start frame in a white hoodie → your ElevenLabs clone measured at 209 / 211 WPM before render → two Wan 2.7 clips → room-tone and level pass → captions → gate
reel.measured: 209 and 211 WPM · 3 and 2 pauses per clip, median 0.47 s · speech −23 dBFS after the level pass · room tone −54 dBFS low-passed
reel.script: Clip 1: Everything you just saw was built by two AI agents talking to each other in a Discord thread, one runs my company's operations and the other writes the code, so I type one paragraph and a character exists by lunch.  Clip 2: The part nobody expects is that she gets graded, three hundred twenty-two real creator reels measured frame by frame, and under seventy it never posts, which is the whole difference between an avatar and a person.
reel.openFixes: brow furrow sits at 0.67 (human ≤ 0.15) and brow raises do not land on the emphasised words; eyes closed slightly too long on the glances down; one uncut 23 s shot; round 1 failed on pauses (28 per minute) and was fixed by flowing sentences and steadier voice settings
